name: watch.element
description: Subscribe to a UIA element's invalidation. Emits a single EVENT when the element is destroyed / re-parented / invalidated, then auto-cancels.

handle.description: Element handle in `elt:N` form, sourced from element.list / element.find / element.tree / element.at / element.wait.

x-event-schema.description: Single EVENT emitted on element invalidation, then auto-cancellation.

reason.description: Why the element was invalidated. `destroyed`: the element no longer exists. `reparented`: tree structure changed. `structure_changed`: child elements added/removed (the element itself still exists).

x-implementations.name: uia_add_structure_changed_handler
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomation::AddStructureChangedEventHandler` registered for the element's subtree. Callback fires on destroyed / reparented / children-changed events.

windows-modern.description: AddStructureChangedEventHandler — UIA's native element-invalidation event. Auto-cancels after the first event fires.
